local
Local binaries (local)

Programs inside the gatekeeper container, run without a shell. A binary is checked for shape at startup, not for existence: name only what the image actually has. Host state such as zfs or ps does not belong here (FR-8.4).

diag:
    executor: local
    binaries: ["/usr/bin/uptime", "/usr/bin/free", "/usr/bin/df"]
    denied_args: []
    path_roots: []
    protected_resources: []
    max_timeout_seconds: 10
    max_output_bytes: 16384
docker
Docker (docker)
Uses the mounted Docker socket. For a remote daemon over TLS, declare a destination with docker_host, docker_tls: true and a docker_tls credential (FR-8.3g).

docker:
    executor: docker
    binaries: ["/usr/bin/docker"]
    denied_args:
      - rm
      - kill
      - exec
      - build
      - push
      - login
      - system
      - prune
      - cp
      - --privileged
      - --force
      - -v
      - --volumes
      - --rmi
    path_roots:
      - "/mnt/CHANGEME"   # where your compose.yaml files live
    protected_resources:
      - "gatekeeper"      # stacks that must never be touched
    max_timeout_seconds: 300
    max_output_bytes: 262144
http
HTTP API (http)

One service's REST API. Scheme and host live only here; tools add a method and a path under allowed_path_prefixes. Keep allowed_cidrs to the /32 of that one host (FR-8.15), and send the credential as a header, never a query parameter (FR-8.14).

myservice:
    executor: http
    base_url: "http://CHANGEME:8080"
    allowed_methods: ["GET", "POST"]
    allowed_path_prefixes:
      - "/api/"   # CHANGEME -- as narrow as the tools need
    allowed_cidrs:
      - "203.0.113.1/32"  # CHANGEME -- e.g. 192.168.1.42/32, this one host
    credential: myservice   # kind api_key_header or bearer, created in /app/credentials
    follow_redirects: false
    max_timeout_seconds: 20
    max_output_bytes: 131072
ssh
Remote host over SSH (ssh)
The same binary and argv model as local, run on another host. Use a dedicated ed25519 key and an unprivileged user; ssh_known_hosts pins the host key.

linux:
    executor: ssh
    ssh_host: "CHANGEME"          # e.g. 192.168.1.50
    ssh_port: 22
    ssh_user: "CHANGEME"          # a dedicated, unprivileged user -- not root
    ssh_known_hosts: "CHANGEME"   # output of: ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 <host>
    binaries: ["/usr/bin/uptime", "/usr/bin/free", "/usr/bin/df"]
    denied_args: []
    path_roots: []
    credential: linux
    max_timeout_seconds: 15
    max_output_bytes: 16384
truenas
TrueNAS (truenas)
JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket. The whitelist is method names: a method that is not listed cannot be called by any tool.

truenas:
    executor: truenas
    ws_url: "wss://CHANGEME/api/current"
    allowed_rpc_methods:
      - pool.query
      - pool.dataset.query
      - zfs.snapshot.query
    credential: truenas
    max_timeout_seconds: 30
    max_output_bytes: 65536
file
Files (file)
Read, write, patch and list inside path_roots, with no binary and no argv. path_roots is the whole restriction, so keep it narrow.

files:
    executor: file
    binaries: []
    path_roots:
      - "/mnt/CHANGEME"
    protected_resources: []
    max_timeout_seconds: 15
    max_output_bytes: 262144
google
Google Workspace (google)

OAuth2: create a credential named google (kind oauth2) in /app/credentials with client_id and client_secret, then Connect Google. Action IDs are the CLI's own spelling, hyphen included (drive create-folder). One toolkit per Google service.

gmail:
    executor: google
    google_script: "/opt/gatekeeper/google/google_api.py"
    allowed_google_actions:
      - gmail search
      - gmail get
    required_scopes:
      - gmail.readonly
    credential: google
    max_timeout_seconds: 30
    max_output_bytes: 131072
microsoft
Microsoft 365 / Outlook (microsoft)

OAuth2 against Microsoft Graph: create a credential named microsoft (kind oauth2) with the app registration's client_id and client_secret, then Connect Microsoft. Keep offline_access, or the credential stops working after an hour.

outlook:
    executor: microsoft
    microsoft_script: "/opt/gatekeeper/microsoft/microsoft_api.py"
    allowed_microsoft_actions:
      - mail list
      - mail get
    required_scopes:
      - Mail.Read
      - User.Read
      - offline_access
    credential: microsoft
    max_timeout_seconds: 30
    max_output_bytes: 131072
opencode
opencode server (opencode)

A headless opencode coding agent. 'run' lets another agent edit files under path_roots: list only ask/check/health for a read-only toolkit. No auth by default; set OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD and a basic credential if it is reachable beyond gatekeeper.

opencode:
    executor: opencode
    base_url: "http://CHANGEME:4096"
    allowed_cidrs:
      - "203.0.113.1/32"  # CHANGEME -- e.g. 192.168.1.42/32, this one host
    allowed_opencode_operations:
      - ask
      - check
      - health
    path_roots:
      - "/mnt/CHANGEME"   # the project roots opencode may be pointed at
    max_timeout_seconds: 900
    max_output_bytes: 131072
git
Push feat/* branches (git)

Pushes one feat/* branch of a listed repository to that repository's remote, fast-forward only: no force, no delete, no main. Create a credential named github (kind bearer, a token that may push to the remote) and mount the repository into the container, read-only is enough.

gkrepo:
    executor: git
    repos:
      CHANGEME:
        path: "/repos/CHANGEME"   # the checkout, as mounted into this container
        remote: "https://github.com/CHANGEME/CHANGEME.git"
    allowed_git_operations:
      - push
    credential: github
    max_timeout_seconds: 120
    max_output_bytes: 16384
kuma
Uptime Kuma monitors (kuma)

Lists, adds, pauses and resumes HTTP monitors over Kuma's Socket.IO API. Create a credential named kuma (kind basic, value username:password) for a Kuma account without 2FA. Pause/resume only touch monitors gatekeeper created; there is no delete or edit.

kuma:
    executor: kuma
    base_url: "http://CHANGEME:3001"
    allowed_cidrs:
      - "203.0.113.1/32"  # CHANGEME -- e.g. 192.168.1.42/32, this one host
    allowed_kuma_operations:
      - monitor_list
      - monitor_add_http
      - monitor_pause
      - monitor_resume
    credential: kuma
    max_timeout_seconds: 30
    max_output_bytes: 131072
agent
Agent mailbox (agent)
Messages between gatekeeper identities, delivered on the recipient's next read. mailbox_path must be on a writable, persistent volume. Stored in plaintext: coordination only, never secrets.

agent:
    executor: agent
    mailbox_path: "/etc/gatekeeper/messages.yaml"
    allowed_agent_operations:
      - send_message
      - read_messages
    max_message_bytes: 4096
    max_mailbox_messages: 200
    max_timeout_seconds: 10
    max_output_bytes: 65536
